blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Tuesday maintained that there was no drama in how authorities handled the arrest and commitment of former House Speaker and Leyte 1st District Rep. Martin Romualdez. “Kung akala niyo over and above yung treatment na binibigay, tingnan niyo yung commitment orders at recommendations ng PGH (Philippine General Hospital). Yun lang ang sinusunod namin. Nothing more and nothing less,” Remulla said in a press briefing in Camp Crame. (If you think we went over and above with his treatment, look at the commitment orders and the PGH’s recommendations. Those are all […]...
